tagline.en: Border to border, Idaho's North and South Highway writ large
tagline.zh: 边境到边境，爱达荷南北公路的放大版

mileageSource: AASHTO route log of 1989, the most recent published, as cited by FHWA highway history

start.en: The Mexican border at San Luis, Arizona, south of Yuma
start.zh: 亚利桑那州圣路易斯的墨西哥边境，位于尤马以南

end.en: The Canadian border at Eastport, Idaho, opposite Kingsgate, British Columbia
end.zh: 爱达荷州伊斯特波特的加拿大边境，对面是不列颠哥伦比亚省金斯盖特

en: US 95 runs from one international border to the other through some of the emptiest country in the lower forty-eight. It starts at the Mexican line at San Luis, crosses the irrigated Yuma valley, and works north through the Sonoran Desert to Quartzsite and across the Colorado River, then through the Mojave to Las Vegas — the only large city on the route. North of Las Vegas it is a Great Basin road: Beatty, Tonopah, Fallon, Winnemucca and the long run to the Oregon line at McDermitt.

Beyond a lightly travelled crossing of southeastern Oregon it becomes Idaho's principal north–south highway, and the two halves of the state are joined by it and almost nothing else. It climbs from the Snake River plain through Weiser and Council, threads the Little Salmon and Salmon river canyons past Riggins, crosses the Camas Prairie to Lewiston by way of the switchbacks off Lewiston Hill, then runs up the Palouse through Moscow to Coeur d'Alene, crosses Lake Pend Oreille on the Long Bridge at Sandpoint, and ends at the border station at Eastport.
zh: US 95 自一国边境通往另一国边境，穿过美国本土四十八州中最空旷的一些地带。它起于圣路易斯的墨西哥边界，横穿灌溉过的尤马河谷，北行经索诺兰沙漠至夸兹赛特并跨越科罗拉多河，再穿莫哈韦沙漠至拉斯维加斯——全线唯一的大城市。拉斯维加斯以北，它是一条大盆地公路：比阿蒂、托诺帕、福伦、温尼马卡，以及通往麦克德米特的俄勒冈州界之间的漫长路段。
在车流稀少地横穿俄勒冈东南部之后，它成为爱达荷州最主要的南北公路；该州南北两半几乎全靠它连在一起。它自斯内克河平原上行，经韦泽与康瑟尔，沿小萨蒙河与萨蒙河峡谷穿过里金斯，横越卡马斯草原，再由刘易斯顿坡的盘山弯道下至刘易斯顿，随后沿帕卢斯丘陵北上，经莫斯科至科达伦，在桑德波因特由长桥跨越彭多雷耶湖，最终止于伊斯特波特的边境站。

en: The number began as one state's road. The Joint Board's 1925 proposal put US 95 entirely inside Idaho, over the North and South Highway that Idaho had been building since the 1910s — the Lewiston Hill section, a ten-mile switchback descent of some two thousand feet, was dedicated in 1917, and the state opened the through route in July 1925 before the last gap was closed. It was finished in 1926 at a cost of over $6 million. The first approved federal log, in 1927, listed US 95 as 483 miles from Eastport to Weiser.

In June 1937 AASHO considered extending it south to Nevada but deferred: Oregon reported that its part of the route would not be fit for travel before 1940. The extension was approved in June 1939, effective 1 January 1940, carrying US 95 through Oregon and Nevada to Blythe, California; the 1942 log put the route at 1,557 miles. The last extension came on 27 June 1960, when AASHO granted a joint Arizona–California request to run US 95 from Ehrenberg through Quartzsite and Yuma to the Mexican border at San Luis, 128 miles, replacing Arizona's State Route 95. The termini have not moved since.
zh: 这个号码起初只是一个州的道路。联合委员会 1925 年的方案把 US 95 完全放在爱达荷州境内，沿该州自 1910 年代起修建的「南北公路」布线——刘易斯顿坡那段十英里、落差约两千英尺的盘山路于 1917 年落成，州政府于 1925 年 7 月在最后一处缺口尚未接通时便开通了全线。它于 1926 年建成，耗资六百余万美元。1927 年首份获批的联邦里程表把 US 95 列为自伊斯特波特至韦泽的 483 英里。

1937 年 6 月，AASHO 考虑把它南延至内华达，但予以暂缓：俄勒冈方面报告说，该州境内的这段路在 1940 年前不适于通行。延伸方案于 1939 年 6 月获批，1940 年 1 月 1 日生效，使 US 95 经俄勒冈与内华达抵加利福尼亚州布莱斯；1942 年的里程表给出全线 1,557 英里。最后一次延伸在 1960 年 6 月 27 日，AASHO 批准亚利桑那与加利福尼亚的联合请求，把 US 95 自埃伦伯格经夸兹赛特与尤马延至圣路易斯的墨西哥边境，计 128 英里，取代亚利桑那州的 95 号州道。此后两端终点未再变动。

en: In Idaho the route's reputation has long been its problem. Governor Cecil Andrus called US 95 the "goat trail", and in January 1988 the Lewiston Morning Tribune reported that the state transportation department classified about 210 miles of it as substandard. Idaho has been widening it to four lanes in pieces ever since, an effort that began in 1999 for the corridor between Lewiston and Moscow alone.

That corridor's last six miles show what the work costs. The Thorn Creek Road to Moscow realignment shifted the highway east onto a new alignment with a flatter grade, fewer curves and a 34-foot median; it opened in 2025 at nearly $90 million, up from an estimate of $57.7 million after litigation over wetland permits forced a redesign and added two bridges over Thorn Creek. Elsewhere the landmark is the Sandpoint crossing of Lake Pend Oreille: the first bridge, a wooden wagon bridge finished in 1910, was two hundred feet short of two miles long and cost $50,000; the concrete bridge that carries the highway today was dedicated on 23 September 1981 at a cost of $11,442,000.
zh: 在爱达荷，这条路的名声一直就是它的问题所在。州长塞西尔·安德鲁斯称 US 95 为「羊道」，1988 年 1 月《刘易斯顿晨报》报道称，州交通部门把其中约 210 英里评定为不达标。此后爱达荷一直分段把它拓宽为四车道；仅刘易斯顿至莫斯科这一段走廊的改造，就是 1999 年启动的。

这段走廊最后的六英里显示出这项工作的代价。桑克里克路至莫斯科的改线工程把公路东移到一条新线上，纵坡更平缓、弯道更少，中央分隔带宽 34 英尺；工程于 2025 年通车，造价近 9,000 万美元，高于 5,770 万美元的原估算——因为围绕湿地许可的诉讼迫使重新设计，并增建了两座跨桑克里克的桥梁。在别处，标志性工程是桑德波因特跨越彭多雷耶湖的桥：1910 年建成的第一座木质马车桥长度比两英里少两百英尺，造价 5 万美元；今日承载公路的混凝土桥于 1981 年 9 月 23 日落成，造价 1,144.2 万美元。

label.zh: 1926 年建成的爱达荷南北公路

value.en: Over $6 million, the cost of the road US 95 was numbered over
value.zh: 六百余万美元，即 US 95 所沿用的那条道路的造价

figures.source: FHWA highway history, 'U.S. 95 and Idaho's North and South Highway', citing Good Roads, December 1926

label.zh: 1981 年桑德波因特跨彭多雷耶湖桥梁

value.en: $11,442,000, on 1,519 piles, dedicated 23 September 1981; the 1910 wooden predecessor had cost $50,000
value.zh: 1,144.2 万美元，共用 1,519 根桩，1981 年 9 月 23 日落成；1910 年的木桥前身造价为 5 万美元

figures.source: Idaho Division of Highways newsletter, quoted in FHWA highway history

label.en: Thorn Creek Road to Moscow realignment, 2022–25
label.zh: 2022—25 年桑克里克路至莫斯科改线

value.en: Nearly $90 million for six miles of four-lane highway on a new alignment, against an earlier estimate of $57.7 million
value.zh: 近 9,000 万美元，在新线上建成六英里四车道公路，而早先的估算为 5,770 万美元

figures.source: Idaho Transportation Department news release, 2025; Lewiston Tribune, July 2025

why.en: No such figure exists for the route as a whole. US 95 grew from a single Idaho highway in 1926 to a border-to-border route by 1960 by absorbing state roads in five more states, each built and paid for separately.
why.zh: 就整条路线而言没有这样的数据。US 95 自 1926 年爱达荷州的一条公路，到 1960 年成为边境到边境的路线，靠的是并入另外五个州的州道，而它们都是各自修建与出资的。

why.en: Six state agencies count their own segments; US 95 is an eight-lane urban freeway in Las Vegas and a two-lane desert road for hundreds of miles in Nevada and Oregon. No combined figure is published.
why.zh: 6 个州的机构各自统计本州路段；US 95 在拉斯维加斯是八车道城市高速路，而在内华达与俄勒冈则有数百英里的沙漠双车道。并无合并数字发布。

label.zh: 1988 年爱达荷境内不达标里程

value.en: About 210 miles classified as substandard by the Idaho Transportation Department
value.zh: 约 210 英里被爱达荷州交通部门评定为不达标

conditionFigures.source: Lewiston Morning Tribune, 17 January 1988, quoted in FHWA highway history

why.en: Condition data are reported to the Federal Highway Administration by state and functional class rather than by U.S. Route number, so no route-level rating exists for US 95.
why.zh: 路况数据按州与功能等级、而非按美国国道编号上报联邦公路管理局，因此不存在针对 US 95 的全线评级。

timeline.en: US 95 is adopted on 11 November over Idaho's newly finished North and South Highway, a route entirely within one state.
timeline.zh: 11 月 11 日，US 95 沿刚建成的爱达荷南北公路获得通过，当时完全位于一州境内。

timeline.en: An extension approved the previous June takes effect, carrying US 95 through Oregon and Nevada to Blythe, California.
timeline.zh: 上一年 6 月获批的延伸方案生效，US 95 经俄勒冈与内华达延至加利福尼亚州布莱斯。

timeline.en: AASHO approves a 128-mile extension from Ehrenberg to the Mexican border at San Luis, replacing Arizona's SR 95.
timeline.zh: AASHO 批准自埃伦伯格至圣路易斯墨西哥边境的 128 英里延伸段，取代亚利桑那 95 号州道。

timeline.en: A new concrete bridge carries US 95 across Lake Pend Oreille at Sandpoint.
timeline.zh: 新建混凝土桥承载 US 95 在桑德波因特跨越彭多雷耶湖。

timeline.en: Idaho begins the long effort to four-lane US 95 from the top of Lewiston Hill to Moscow.
timeline.zh: 爱达荷启动把刘易斯顿坡顶至莫斯科的 US 95 改为四车道的长期工程。

timeline.en: The last six miles of that corridor open, completing the four-lane route between Lewiston and Moscow.
timeline.zh: 该走廊最后六英里通车，刘易斯顿至莫斯科的四车道路线由此贯通。
